info.title: MoneyToHome — API vận hành AI
info.description: MoneyToHome reads and records stock assignments and observed VM/EarnApp work. It does not connect to, create, configure or log in to real VMs, EarnApp or PayPal. Base: https://wow.lalamail.sbs/api/ops/v1. Bearer token; every POST needs Idempotency-Key (no PIN). Effective rights are current user rights intersected with token projects and scopes. Owner creates the 90-day operator token in the UI with READ, VM_OPS, BALANCE_WRITE, PROXY_CREDENTIALS, ACCOUNT_OPS; no PAYOUT or RECEIPT. Assigned proxy credentials are available directly for the active VM job with PROXY_CREDENTIALS and VM_PROXY_FOR_OPS. Inventory account credentials and SDK reveals are direct with current token/user/server rights; no ADMIN approval or TOTP. Only withdrawal prepare/status/receipts retain approval. Standalone approval holds return 202 ok:false; a pending batch returns 202 ok:true with per-item results, summary and one approval. Final batch returns 200 even with refused items. Stock writes require the caller token own ACTIVE, unexpired job for that VM and round. Read back current state; an API acknowledgement proves a web record only. SDK and account usage are separate facts, never inferred from assignment or money.

details.description: Filtered by rights. On 409: `current` = the state now (VM: expectedCycle, revision, earnAppAccountId; or the withdrawal). DUPLICATE: withdrawalId / receiptId. SDK_CONFLICT (SDK survey): kind CURRENT_DIFFERS (observedCode, currentCode, currentSdkId, currentRevision, currentLinkState) or SAME_TIME_OTHER_AMOUNT (code, sdkId, revision, storedAmountUsd, observedAt). REVISION_CONFLICT on an SDK: code + sdk {sdkId, revision, linkState} (null = the code is not stored). APPROVAL_REJECTED (403): approvalId, status "REJECTED". APPROVAL_EXPIRED (410): approvalId, expiredAt. (The 202 APPROVAL_REQUIRED hold has its own schema ApprovalRequired.)

amount.description: USD read on this VM in this round; null = not checked here yet (a figure of an earlier round / another VM is in `stored`), not readable, or hidden (missing is never 0)

observedAt.description: when that amount was seen on this VM in this round; null = none / unknown time (old money) / hidden

recordedAt.description: when the amount was written on the web (not when it was seen)

failedAt.description: the latest reading on this VM in this round that could NOT read the money (amountRead:false); the last good figure stays in `amount`. null = none / hidden

moneyState.description: the same state the web shows at the row (src/lib/vm-money.ts): UNCHECKED = no reading on this VM in this round (never 0); OK; STALE = older than 24 h; FAILED = the latest reading failed, the last good figure kept; NO_TIME = money recorded before observation times existed; HIDDEN = no money read right

stored.description: the code's own latest figure wherever it was read (null without the read right)

cycle.description: the VM round it was checked in

vmId.description: the VM it was checked on

items.description: every code of the VM list. amount / observedAt / failedAt / moneyState are the readings checked on THIS VM in ITS CURRENT ROUND (the state the web shows at the row); `stored` is the code's own latest figure wherever it was read (history: an earlier round, another VM); never added up into a VM figure; not the EarnApp balance

exact.description: true only with an amount in USD

dailyAllowed.description: False: cannot use this email for a new payout today; select another PP or wait. A bound email is never switched automatically.

dailyOccupied.description: This email already belongs to today used/reserved capacity; selecting it again does not take another slot. Check dailyAllowed separately.

outcome.description: SAVED = new figure stored; SAME = same figure, check time moved (or identical replay of the stored time); OLDER = a newer observation is stored, its money is kept; UNREADABLE = could not read (kept, never 0); NOT_SENT = no money in the request

amountUsd.description: stored amount after this command; null without the balance read right or not recorded

revisionAfter.description: SDK revision after this command (the next expectedSdkRevision)

found.description: false = not stored in this project (a code of another project also reads as not found)

revision.description: send as expectedSdkRevision (null when not found)

inListOf.description: VM whose SDK list holds the code (null = store)

currentOf.description: VM where it is the current code

failedAt.description: latest failed reading of the code

observedCycle.description: the VM round the stored amount was checked in

observedVmId.description: the VM the stored amount was checked on

nextCursor.description: Only present without code parameters (list mode). Pass as cursor on the next page; null means no more rows. Omitted from legacy supplied-code lookup.

SdkLookup.description: Shared item schema for supplied-code lookup and stored-SDK listing. nextCursor exists only in list mode; money access rules remain unchanged.

ApprovalRequired.description: HTTP 202 for a standalone privileged command: not executed until ADMIN approval via CLI or web. Retry identical key/body after approval. This is also the body of each waiting batch item; the outer batch uses OkBatchResult.

expiresAt.description: 15 phút kể từ yêu cầu đầu tiên; sau mốc này gửi lại với key mới

ApprovalExpired.description: HTTP 410: yêu cầu duyệt đã hết hạn (15 phút), lệnh chưa ghi; gửi lại với Idempotency-Key MỚI để xin duyệt lại.

code.description: Mã SDK ĐẦY ĐỦ (duy nhất chỗ không che); trả trực tiếp theo quyền hiện tại, không ghi vào nhật ký máy hay chat

currentOf.description: VM đang dùng mã này làm mã hiện hành (null = chưa là mã hiện hành của VM nào)

id.description: Login stock id (loginId), NOT the EarnApp accountId used in write paths.

state.description: UNUSED is an active login with no EarnApp row or an unregistered, unclosed EarnApp row with no VM. HELD is on a live VM without registration; registered/closed or left on a deleted VM is USED. A prior credential reveal is not registration evidence and does not itself prevent release/reuse; an unknown actual registration outcome must remain held.

revision.description: EarnApp account revision; send as expectedRevision for used/release (0 if no EarnApp row).

AccountUsedBody.description: sdkId is optional; when supplied expectedSdkRevision is mandatory and non-null. Marks registeredAt from real successful registration/login; optionally links the current SDK atomically. Does not perform login.

ProxyAssignBody.description: Exactly one of proxyId or pick. pick.packageCode is the service field (not pick.package). Assigning in MoneyToHome does not install on a real VM.

summary.description: Allowed summary only; batch summaries include per-item summaries, never secret results.

totp.description: ADMIN TOTP from hidden terminal prompt or --totp-stdin; never persist in business/client journals, files, logs or chat. No code in command arguments.

body.description: The exact standalone endpoint envelope: 200 success, 202 ApprovalRequired or error for this item.

endpointId.description: Desired endpoint ID only; not evidence of native installation.

proxyAddressFingerprint.description: ADDRESS ONLY: lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 host.trim().toLowerCase()+"|"+port for the desired endpoint. Null when unknown/invalid. Excludes protocol and credentials, never configurationHash or proof of native application. Bridge compares the native address fingerprint before endpoint mapping; appliedConfigurationId stays null absent independent full configuration proof.

PaypalDailyEmails.description: Max two distinct emails per PP per Vietnam day. Open preparations/unknowns reserve capacity across midnight; sent or uncertain attempts consume their server-date slot, even if cancelled later. Same email/key is not counted twice.

MonitorHeartbeatBody.description: Closed snapshot. startedAt <= observedAt <= receipt; coverage axes <= managed. Exact configured project/server/source/serverUuid enrollment required. Counts are reported coverage, never VM proof.

post.summary: SDK codes seen RUNNING on the machine (survey: no install, job or EarnApp account needed), with the accumulated USD read there (Tiền tích luỹ SDK; money needs BALANCE_WRITE on the token and EARN_BALANCE on the user). Every code carries the SDK revision read (GET vms/{id} sdk.items[].revision or GET sdks; null only when the code is not stored). New codes are saved "Chưa xác nhận"; codes of this VM keep their state (a used code stays used). A code of another VM, a used / unconfirmed code outside this VM or of another project (DUPLICATE), a VM whose current code is another one when current:true (SDK_CONFLICT CURRENT_DIFFERS), the same observedAt with another figure (SDK_CONFLICT SAME_TIME_OTHER_AMOUNT), a stale round / VM / SDK revision refuse the whole command (nothing written). An older observedAt never replaces a newer stored reading (amount.outcome OLDER). Never changes the EarnApp account, the VM status or install marks; never an EarnApp balance, income, cost or "withdrawable". recorded is the first acknowledgement (identical on replay); current is the VM now.

observedAt.description: when the machine was read (not when this is sent); not in the future

source.description: where it was read, e.g. "AE Mini Tool · màn hình EarnApp"

sdks.description: one entry per code; the same code twice (two files on the machine) is one SDK; two different amounts for it are refused

expectedSdkRevision.description: revision of the stored code as read; null = the code was not stored when read (a code created meanwhile is refused, never overwritten)

amountUsd.description: USD read and checked (decimals kept, up to 6; "0" is a value). OCR text such as "5_17" or "5,17" is refused, never guessed. Needs BALANCE_WRITE + EARN_BALANCE

amountRead.description: false = the money could not be read this time (the stored amount is kept, never 0); true needs amountUsd; absent with no amountUsd = no money in this request

current.description: the code the machine runs now: becomes the VM current code when the VM has none; a VM with another current code refuses the command (SDK_CONFLICT)

evidence.description: evidence note (e.g. screenshot reference); never passwords, 2FA or links with codes

post.summary: Run 1–100 independent ordered write items
post.description: Outer Idempotency-Key durably binds the whole payload even without privileged items; a changed payload under that key is 409. Distinct item keys keep their own audit/replay. Paths are relative API POST routes, excluding batch and approvals/{id}/confirm; no external URLs. Missing item body.projectId is filled from the batch; a different item projectId is a per-item VALIDATION refusal. Outer-key binding is token-specific; rotating the token does not resume this batch key. Items run sequentially, not atomically: route/scope/service refusal is per item and others continue. Privileged items share one approval hashing the entire batch. Nonprivileged items run while approval is pending. Retry identical outer key/body: completed items replay; approved items may execute. A final 200 can still contain refused items: inspect every item. One write hit plus batch bucket 10/minute/token, no per-item write hits. No secret results stored by the outer-key binding.
